subject_exact: reported effective Lemon Squeezy fee creep (10-18% with add-ons) since Stripe acquisition
snippet_primary: "Lemon Squeezy established itself as a creator-friendly merchant of record (MoR) platform with an elegant interface and all-in-one approach to digital commerce. However, since the Stripe acquisition in July 2024, the landscape has shifted considerably. Users now report extended onboarding times, unclear product roadmaps, and fee structures that can climb to 10-18% with add-ons—well above the advertised 5% + 50¢ base rate."
